verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents several built-in AI features that take on specific tasks. The AI Editor builds and edits ingestion workflows from natural language prompts, Sprinto AI validates uploaded evidence and flags gaps, and AI-assisted due diligence reviews are offered. These are scoped features, not a general assistant you can hand arbitrary tasks to across the product. missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product AI assistant or agent for open-ended delegation, documentation of the assistant's scope, actions and approval flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Sprinto’s AI Editor helps you create and modify ingestion workflows using natural language prompts.
Use Sprinto AI to automatically validate your uploaded evidence for relevance, scope, and timeliness before audit submission.
Sprinto supports both manual and AI-assisted due diligence reviews.
